per_article_summaries: Allan McNish says the next power unit update will not be until 2027. The reason is to stay within the budget cap, according to the Sauber racing director. Audi has scored points in the last three rounds, edging Williams out of eighth.

David Coulthard has praised Lando Norris after his victory at the Hungarian Grand Prix. The McLaren driver secured the first grand prix victory of the season for both himself and McLaren at the Hungaroring. Kimi Antonelli leads the drivers' standings with 219 points. Lewis Hamilton is second with 169 points and George Russell is third with 160 points.

Max Verstappen says he is "feeling good" about his place in Formula 1. The Red Bull driver says he can easily walk away tomorrow if he wanted to. The 28-year-old is unhappy with the 2026 power unit regulations and Red Bull's chassis.

Rachel Brookes has predicted a massive overhaul of the F1 grid. She tipped Max Verstappen to join Mercedes and McLaren's Oscar Piastri to replace him at Red Bull. An all-British line-up at McLaren and moves to Audi, Alpine and Williams for Carlos Sainz, Fernando Alonso and Franco Colapinto also suggested.

Oliver Bearman has reaffirmed his commitment to the Ferrari driver programme. The 21-year-old was speaking on the F1 Beyond The Grid podcast. Bearman is 13th in the drivers' championship with 18 points after the first half of the 2026 season.
